# Condition

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Condition)*

A condition is a temporary game state. The definition of a condition says how it affects its recipient, and various rules define how to end a condition. This glossary defines these conditions:

- [Blinded](Blinded.md)
- [Charmed](Charmed.md)
- [Deafened](Deafened.md)
- [Exhaustion](Exhaustion.md)
- [Frightened](Frightened.md)
- [Grappled](Grappled.md)
- [Incapacitated](Incapacitated.md)
- [Invisible](Invisible.md)
- [Paralyzed](Paralyzed.md)
- [Petrified](Petrified.md)
- [Poisoned](Poisoned.md)
- [Prone](Prone.md)
- [Restrained](Restrained.md)
- [Stunned](Stunned.md)
- [Unconscious](Unconscious.md)

A condition doesn't stack with itself; a recipient either has a condition or doesn't. The Exhaustion condition is an exception to that rule. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Conditions](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#Conditions)").
